item.kingdomkeys.looming_darkness.desc: A room where Heartless attack relentlessly. Enemies often drop enemy cards in this room.
item.kingdomkeys.lost_memory.desc: A Keyblade with long reach that makes it easier to land critical hits, and deals higher damage when you do.
item.kingdomkeys.lunar_eclipse.desc: A weapon that boosts versatility by greatly boosting both Strength and Magic.
item.kingdomkeys.mark_of_a_hero.desc: A Keyblade that provides an extra boost in Strength and deals higher damage when you land a critical hit.
item.kingdomkeys.martial_waking.desc: A room where attacks are more effective.
item.kingdomkeys.masters_defender.desc: Master Eraqus's Keyblade. All of its stats are high.
item.kingdomkeys.maverick_flare.desc: A weapon that offers high Strength and ground combo speed.
item.kingdomkeys.metal_chocobo.desc: Possesses incredible power and reach, but reduces max MP by 1. Rarely deals critical blows.
item.kingdomkeys.midnight_blue.desc: A Keyblade imbued with wondrous power.
item.kingdomkeys.midnight_roar.desc: A weapon that possesses high Strength. Useful against tough enemies.
item.kingdomkeys.mingling_worlds.desc: A room where anything could happen.
item.kingdomkeys.mirage_split.desc: A Keyblade formed from a Reality Shift in The World That Never Was.
item.kingdomkeys.missing_ache.desc: A weapon that lets you string together faster, longer ground combos.
item.kingdomkeys.moments_reprieve.desc: A room where you can save your progress. No Heartless.
item.kingdomkeys.monochrome.desc: Increases the effect of restoration items used on the field.
item.kingdomkeys.moogle_room.desc: A room where you can trade cards at the Moogle Shop.
item.kingdomkeys.mysterious_abyss.desc: Enhances magic to increase damage dealt by blizzard-based attacks.
item.kingdomkeys.nightmares_end.desc: A Keyblade formed from a Reality Shift in The World That Never Was.
item.kingdomkeys.nightmares_end_and_mira: A Keyblade formed by combining both the Mirage Split and Nightmare's End.
item.kingdomkeys.no_name.desc: The Keyblade that Luxu received from the Master of Masters, containing his very own eye.
item.kingdomkeys.no_name_bbs.desc: A Keyblade with long reach that provides an outstanding boost in Magic and makes it easier to land critical hits.
item.kingdomkeys.oathkeeper.desc: Enhances magic and increases the duration of a Drive Form.
item.kingdomkeys.oblivion.desc: Has great strength, and allows the Drive Gauge to restore quickly during MP Charge.
item.kingdomkeys.oceans_rage.desc: A Keyblade that lands fewer critical hits, but compensates with a boost in Magic and more frequent Reality Shifts.
item.kingdomkeys.olympia.desc: A powerful weapon that is difficult to deflect. Capable of inflicting mighty critical blows.
item.kingdomkeys.omega_weapon.desc: A formidable weapon with exceptional capabilities.
item.kingdomkeys.ominous_blight.desc: A weapon that lets you string together faster, much longer ground combos.
item.kingdomkeys.one_winged_angel.desc: Raises max MP by 1, and enhances magic and summon power. Also deals great physical damage.
item.kingdomkeys.pain_of_solitude.desc: A weapon that boosts your Magic to give it more power.
item.kingdomkeys.phantom_green.desc: A Keyblade imbued with wondrous power.
item.kingdomkeys.photon_debugger.desc: Increases damage done by thunder-based attacks.
item.kingdomkeys.pixie_petal.desc: A Keyblade that makes up for its poor reach with an extra boost in Magic. It also makes it easier to land critical hits, and deals higher damage when you do.
item.kingdomkeys.pumpkinhead.desc: Has a long reach and the ability to deal a string of critical blows.
item.kingdomkeys.rainfell.desc: The Keyblade Aqua started out with. What it lacks in reach it makes up for with a balanced boost to Strength and Magic.
item.kingdomkeys.random_card_pack.desc: A pack of 5 Map Cards of any color, open to reveal them.
item.kingdomkeys.red_card_pack.desc: A pack of 5 red Map Cards, open to reveal them.
item.kingdomkeys.rejection_of_fate.desc: A weapon that enables your attacks to reach a wide area and deal immense damage.
item.kingdomkeys.reposeful_grove.desc: A room where peaceful mobs appear.
item.kingdomkeys.roulette_bonus.desc: Grants a random Map Card through a roulette.
item.kingdomkeys.roulette_room.desc: A room where victory often leads to Roulette Bonuses.
item.kingdomkeys.royal_radiance.desc: A Keyblade with long reach that makes it easier to land critical hits, and deals higher damage when you do.
item.kingdomkeys.rumbling_rose.desc: Has great strength, allowing finishing combo moves to be unleashed successively.
item.kingdomkeys.shooting_star.desc: A Keyblade with an emphasis on Magic.
item.kingdomkeys.sign_of_innocence.desc: A weapon that boosts your Magic to give it a lot more power.
item.kingdomkeys.silent_dirge.desc: A weapon that provides versatility by boosting both Strength and Magic.
item.kingdomkeys.skull_noise.desc: A Keyblade that provides a balanced boost in Strength and Magic.
item.kingdomkeys.sleeping_darkness.desc: A room where Heartless are drowsy and easy to ambush.
item.kingdomkeys.sleeping_lion.desc: Well-balanced with strength and magic, increasing maximum ground-based combos by 1.
item.kingdomkeys.sorcerous_waking.desc: A room where spells are more effective.
item.kingdomkeys.soul_eater.desc: A sword that swims with darkness. Possesses high Strength.
item.kingdomkeys.spellbinder.desc: Raises max MP by 2, and significantly enhances magic and summon power.
item.kingdomkeys.stagnant_space.desc: A room where the Heartless move slowly.
item.kingdomkeys.star_cluster.desc: Mickey's Keyblade, also known as Kingdom Key W.
item.kingdomkeys.star_seeker.desc: Increases maximum combo by 1 when in midair.
item.kingdomkeys.starlight.desc: A basic Keyblade which is associated with the force of Light.
item.kingdomkeys.stormfall.desc: A well-balanced Keyblade that provides an extra boost to all your stats.
item.kingdomkeys.stroke_of_midnight.desc: A Keyblade that makes it easier to land critical hits.
item.kingdomkeys.sweet_dreams.desc: A Keyblade with long reach that provides an extra boost in Strength and makes it easier to land critical hits.
item.kingdomkeys.sweet_memories.desc: Although it does not enhance attack strength, it increases the drop rate of items.
item.kingdomkeys.sweetstack.desc: A Keyblade that provides an extra boost in Strength and ensures every strike is a critical hit.
item.kingdomkeys.teeming_darkness.desc: A room where many Heartless appear. Enemies often drop enemy cards in this room.
item.kingdomkeys.three_wishes.desc: A powerful weapon that is difficult to deflect.
item.kingdomkeys.total_eclipse.desc: A weapon that possesses extreme Strength. Devastates tough enemies.
item.kingdomkeys.tranquil_darkness.desc: A room where only a few Heartless appear.
A room where ores are guarded by Heartless.
item.kingdomkeys.treasure_trove.desc: A Keyblade that makes up for its poor reach with a balanced boost in Strength and Magic.
item.kingdomkeys.true_lights_flight.desc: A weapon that enables your attacks to reach a wide area and deal heavy damage.
item.kingdomkeys.twilight_blaze.desc: A weapon that boasts superior Strength and ground combo speed.
item.kingdomkeys.two_become_one.desc: A weapon of great strength and magic that has a special effect.
item.kingdomkeys.ultima_weapon_ddd.desc: An outstanding Keyblade that boosts all stats, and makes it easy to both land critical hits and trigger Reality Shifts.
item.kingdomkeys.ultima_weapon_kh1.desc: The ultimate Keyblade. Raises max MP by 2, and possesses maximum power and attributes.
item.kingdomkeys.ultima_weapon_kh2.desc: The Keyblade above all others, holding all power and will increase MP restoration rate, once all MP has been consumed.
item.kingdomkeys.unbound.desc: Keyblade perfection. It boosts all stats, while making it easy to land critical hits and even easier to trigger Reality Shifts.
item.kingdomkeys.victory_line.desc: A Keyblade with above-average reach that makes it easier to land critical hits.
item.kingdomkeys.void_gear.desc: A Keyblade with long reach that provides an outstanding boost in Strength and deals higher damage when you land a critical hit.
item.kingdomkeys.void_gear_remnant.desc: A Keyblade with long reach that provides an outstanding boost in Strength and deals higher damage when you land a critical hit.
item.kingdomkeys.wayward_wind.desc: The Keyblade Ventus started out with. What it lacks in reach it makes up for with a slight boost in Strength.
item.kingdomkeys.weightless_space.desc: A room where gravity feels weaker.
item.kingdomkeys.wheel_of_fate.desc: A Keyblade with an emphasis on Strength.
item.kingdomkeys.white_room.desc: A room where only White Mushrooms appear. What happens when you defeat White Mushrooms?
item.kingdomkeys.winners_proof.desc: Has high strength and hold's an excellent magic power. When the enemies are defeated, experience points are not gained.
item.kingdomkeys.wishing_lamp.desc: Wishes come true by increasing the drop rate of munny, HP and MP orbs.
item.kingdomkeys.wishing_star.desc: Has a short reach, but always finishes up a combo attack with a powerful critical blow.
item.kingdomkeys.young_xehanorts_keyblad: The Keyblade weilded by Young Xehanort.
item.kingdomkeys.zero_one.desc: A Keyblade newly wrought within the datascape. Its powers render all opponents helpless.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.blast_blox: TNT-like with more destructive power, triggers on contact with anything but a feather in your hand.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.bounce_blox: Entities that step on this block will bounce, sneak to land on the block without bouncing.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.danger_blox: Similar to a Cactus but deals more damage, causes damage on contact and also when hit. Unlike a Cactus it has no placement limits or growth. Wear boots to avoid damage while walking on them.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.final_orb: Use to unlock Final Form. Final has a 2nd Keyblade slot. Activation requires 5 bars of the Drive Gauge. Dropped from breaking Rare Prize Blox.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.ghost_blox: Apply a redstone signal to toggle the visibility of the Ghost Blox and all adjacent Ghost Blox, while in the invisible state they have no collision.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.keychains: Keychains can be used to summon the associated Keyblade by equipping the keychain through the Kingdom Keys menu, use the summon key to summon the Keyblade.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.limit_orb: Use to unlock Limit Form. Activation requires 4 bars of the Drive Gauge. Dropped from breaking Rare Prize Blox.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.magnet_blox: Pulls or pushes entities in the direction its facing. Apply a redstone signal to activate, right click to change the range and sneak-right click with your fist to toggle attract and repel mode.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.master_orb: Use to unlock Master Form. Master has a 2nd Keyblade slot. Activation requires 4 bars of the Drive Gauge. Dropped from breaking Rare Prize Blox.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.moogle_projector: Obtained from Moogles when killed by an Anvil. Used for Item Synthesis and upgrading Keyblades via the Keyblade Forge and depositing materials used for Synthesis. Moogles also serve the same purpose as this.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.organization_robes: Wear the full Organization set to join and select a member to start with, no matter who you choose you can unlock every member's weapons however it requires unlocking the adjacent member's weapon first.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.organization_weapon: As an Organization member you can unlock weapons within the equipment menu by spending hearts gained from kills, you will earn 2x hearts from using a weapon from your chosen member. Summon the weapons using the summon key.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.proof_of_heart: Obtained from defeating the Ender Dragon, use this to leave the Organization.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.recipes: Dropped from mobs and found in Moogle house chests in villages. Use these to unlock recipes for Item Synthesis.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.spell_orb: Use to unlock the specified spell. Once unlocked magic can be used with the Command Menu as long as you have enough MP, until level 5 you will have 0 MP. Dropped from breaking Prize Blox.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.valor_orb: Use to unlock Valor Form. Valor has a 2nd Keyblade slot. Activation requires 3 bars of the Drive Gauge. Dropped from breaking Rare Prize Blox.
jei.info.kingdomkeys.wisdom_orb: Use to unlock Wisdom Form. Activation requires 3 bars of the Drive Gauge. Dropped from breaking Rare Prize Blox.
